title: Why in? Diaphane, adiaphane. If you can put your five fingers through it it is a gate, if not a door.
html_source:
Mimics Samuel Johnson

‘Door is used of house, and gates of cities and public buildings’ (Gifford).

In other words Stephen is investigating Berkeley’s philosophy. If he closes his eyes and Berkeley’s right, the objects won’t exist. Joyce undoes Berkeley through the use of another sense (hearing) in the next paragraph.
